summary: Describes an Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) mapping for provisioning and managing organization objects stored in a shared central repository. EPP is used by domain registries and registrars. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Domain registries keep records about domains and people. This document adds a record type for companies and other organizations so they can be stored and managed the same way.

questions: how to manage organizations in a registry
